vial_spin_stop_sequence — PHARMA synth op

• Datenarten: keine → video (ein Operator, der allein durch seine Argumente bestimmt ist — er nimmt kein Bild und keine Daten entgegen)

• Aufruf: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vial_spin_stop_sequence(shape=(96, 72), *, n_frames=18, frame_interval_s=0.04, initial_omega_rad_s=10.0, decay_time_s=0.25, vial_radius_mm=10.0, liquid_height_mm=28.0, particle_diameter_um=80.0, particle_density_kg_m3=1450.0, particle_contrast=0.16, illumination='back', n_particles=1, n_bubbles=1, n_scratches=1, viscosity_pa_s=0.003, fluid_density_kg_m3=1000.0, pixel_size_um=280.0, noise_sigma=0.012, seed=0) (die Implementierung direkt: import vialops; vialops.vial_spin_stop_sequence(shape=(96, 72), *, n_frames=18, frame_interval_s=0.04, initial_omega_rad_s=10.0, decay_time_s=0.25, vial_radius_mm=10.0, liquid_height_mm=28.0, particle_diameter_um=80.0, particle_density_kg_m3=1450.0, particle_contrast=0.16, illumination='back', n_particles=1, n_bubbles=1, n_scratches=1, viscosity_pa_s=0.003, fluid_density_kg_m3=1000.0, pixel_size_um=280.0, noise_sigma=0.012, seed=0); aus dem Register: opspharma.get("vial_spin_stop_sequence"))

• Rückgabewert über das Register: fullseye.ledger.vial_spin_stop_sequence(...) liefert nur den Wert des deklarierten Out-Typs video (die zugrunde liegende Funktion gibt zusätzlich Hilfsinformationen zurück). Wird das Verworfene gebraucht, nutze fullseye.ledger.vial_spin_stop_sequence.raw(...) oder rufe vialops.vial_spin_stop_sequence direkt auf.

• GPU: nein (nur CPU-Referenzimplementierung)

Verwendung

Erzeugt eine Bildsequenz eines Vials nach dem Rotationsstopp und Grundwahrheits-Trajektorien je Objekt.

> Die ausführliche Beschreibung unten ist der Originaltext — Zusammenfassung und Überschriften sind übersetzt.

The liquid azimuthal velocity is the axisymmetric, prescribed field u_theta(r,t) = omega0 exp(-t/tau) r; it is not a Navier--Stokes solution. A particle has that in-plane advection plus its Stokes terminal velocity v_t = 2 r_p^2 (rho_p-rho_f) g / (9 mu) in the image-downward direction. Bubbles use rho_p=1.2 kg/m^3 and therefore rise. The model is restricted to small Reynolds number / isolated spherical objects where Stokes drag is appropriate; it does not model turbulent wake, aggregation, meniscus forces, or wall-corrected drag. At the cylindrical wall positions are reflected, which prevents a silent escape but is not a hydrodynamic wall model. Refraction through glass and liquid is deliberately simplified to a fixed apparent contrast and Gaussian PSF in this first stage.

illumination is "back" or "side". A fixed seed determines object positions, sensor noise, and scratches. The direct return is (frames, truth); truth contains a row table with object type, frame, projected positions, physical positions and visibility, plus angular-speed truth. The ledger adapter returns only the video frames.

The rendered outline is a display-only 2R-like profile, not a metrology calibration. Its public dimensional source is ISO 8362-1:2018(E), Table 1 (2R: 16 mm body, 13 mm finish, 35 mm overall height, 8 mm finish height), previewed at https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/74398/343407bc7b564f6184bfa0a9decede14/ISO-8362-1-2018.pdf. An independent public 2R product listing confirms the 16 mm body and 35 mm overall height at https://www.westpharma.com/es-es/products/vial-containment-solutions/vials/nuova-ompi-sg-ez-fill-glass-vials-sterile-3-8-10. 描画外形は計測校正ではなく、公開 ISO 8362-1:2018(E) Table 1 の 2R 比率を使う表示モデルである。独立した公開製品寸法も上記 URL で確認する。

Raises ValueError for nonphysical dimensions, an unknown illumination, or a nonintegral object count.
